verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a hosted software service, so asking whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack shows a public repository, an open-source license, or any source-availability statement. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes show machine-readable documentation, not open source code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
